AI Lead-Reply Automation — Demo Project

A home-cleaning business was losing quote requests in a busy inbox. This automation captures every lead, drafts a personal reply, and follows up on its own — the owner just reviews and clicks send.

Scenario
Cleaning business · quote requests
Built with
Make · Sheets · Gmail · AI
Project type
Self-initiated demo · sample data

01 / The Problem

Good leads, lost in the inbox

Small cleaning businesses win work by replying fast — but the owner is usually out on a job, not watching email. Three things go wrong, every week:

PAIN — 01

Slow first replies

A quote request sits unread for hours. By the time the owner replies, the customer has already booked whoever answered first.

PAIN — 02

Leads scattered & forgotten

Requests arrive by form, email and phone with no single list. Nothing tracks who was answered, who was quoted, or who went quiet.

PAIN — 03

No follow-up, ever

A polite nudge two days later recovers a share of silent leads — but manually remembering every open thread is the first thing that slips.

The fix isn't a bigger inbox — it's a system that never forgets a lead. The automation below handles capture, drafting and follow-up. The owner keeps the only step that needs a human: approving what goes out.

02 / The Workflow

Five steps, zero copy-pasting

One Make scenario connects the tools the business already uses. From the moment a request lands, everything up to the send button is automatic.

01

New lead arrives

A quote request comes in through the website form or the business inbox — name, home size, service wanted.

→
02

Make captures it

The automation triggers instantly, reads the message and pulls out the details that matter — no manual entry.

→
03

Logged in Sheets

One clean CRM row per lead: contact, job details, source, date and status. The whole pipeline in a single view.

→
04

AI drafts the reply

A personal reply — with a quote from the business's own rate card — is written and saved as a Gmail draft.

→
05

48h follow-up

No reply in 48 hours? A polite follow-up draft is prepared automatically. The thread closes the moment they respond.

The human stays in charge: nothing is ever sent automatically. Every AI draft waits in Gmail for the owner's one-click review — approve, tweak, or delete. The system does the chasing; the owner does the talking.

03 / A Worked Example

One lead, start to finishSample Data

A fictional lead, run through the exact workflow above — what arrives, and the draft the system prepares for approval.

Sarah M.via website quote form · Austin
Incoming

Hi! I found your cleaning company online and I'd love a quote.

We have a 3-bedroom, 2-bath house in Austin, about 1,800 sq ft. We'd like a deep clean before we host family next month — and possibly bi-weekly cleans after that if it goes well.

Could you let me know pricing and your earliest availability?

Thanks,
Sarah M.

Draft replysaved in Gmail · waiting for approval
AI Draft

Hi Sarah — thanks for getting in touch!

A deep clean for a 3-bed, 2-bath home of around 1,800 sq ft is right in our wheelhouse, and we'd be glad to have your place guest-ready before your family visit.

From our rate card: a first deep clean for a home your size runs $210–$260, and bi-weekly cleans after that start at $139 per visit. Final quote confirmed once we see the home.

We currently have openings next week — would Tuesday or Thursday morning suit you for a first clean? Just reply here and I'll lock it in.

Best regards,
The BrightHome Cleaning team

Lead logged in Sheets → status: “Draft ready” Owner reviews & sends in under a minute. If Sarah goes quiet, the 48-hour follow-up draft appears on its own.

04 / Tools & Stack

Built from tools the business already has

No new platform to learn and no data handed to a stranger — the whole system runs inside the client's own accounts.

Automation Engine

Make

Watches the inbox/form, moves the data between steps and runs the 48-hour follow-up timer.

Lead CRM

Google Sheets

One row per lead with status tracking — the owner sees every request and where it stands, at a glance.

Replies & Sending

Gmail

AI drafts land as real Gmail drafts in the business's own mailbox, ready for one-click approval and send.

Drafting

AI Model

Reads each request and writes a personal reply using the business's services, tone and rate card — never a generic template.
